# `end_of_line`

Line ending to write. auto matches whatever the source uses.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `lf` |  |
| `crlf` |  |
| `auto` |  |

**Default:** `auto`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```

### `end_of_line = lf`

```ini
end_of_line = lf
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `end_of_line = crlf`

```ini
end_of_line = crlf
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```

### `end_of_line = auto`

```ini
end_of_line = auto
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
